en: A vintage printed postcard depicting a hillside landscape with a fortified monastery‑like complex or large building on top, surrounded by cypress trees and sparse vegetation. The sky is lightly clouded. Under the image there is Greek text, a caption at the left and a publisher credit at the right, along with a faint circular emblem and the website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr'. There is also handwritten text in purple ink on the right side of the card.
